jp.kyasu.graphics

クラス EchoTextScanner

  • java.lang.Object
    • jp.kyasu.graphics.TextScanner
      • jp.kyasu.graphics.EchoTextScanner

  • public class EchoTextScanner
extends TextScanner
    The EchoTextScanner class scans text to lay out text, to draw text, and to compute the position of text. Each character in the text is treated as the specified echo character. The EchoTextScanner class is useful when the user input shouldn't be echoed to the screen, as in the case of a password field.
